title: South Korea Floats 'Citizen Dividend' to Distribute AI Productivity Gains
detail: South Korea's government proposed a 'citizen dividend' policy that would distribute gains from AI productivity to the public, rattling financial markets and triggering broad debate about AI wealth redistribution. The proposal positions South Korea as an early mover on AI dividend frameworks as the country's tech sector rapidly adopts AI-driven automation.

media.caption: South Korea proposes citizen dividend for AI productivity gains
